items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I only know him by his nickname.

ctx.x: Who was the cat that left?
Scotty. I just remember... You know, maybe his name was Scott. I only know him by his nickname. You know how so many musicians are just known by their nicknames.
